subject.title: WhatsApp 1:1: inbound image wedges main lane ~3min before processing — multimodal run strands active_reply_work/queued_work_without_active_run (repro on 2026.6.10, post-#95039)

question: Does current main plus the broader WhatsApp lane tracker fully cover this image/multimodal active_reply_work report, or should this stay open as the focused live-repro target?
rationale: The report has fresh release evidence and a distinct trigger, while current main contains adjacent recovery changes that were not proven against WhatsApp images in this read-only review.

options.title: Keep Focused Until Live Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open, run a current-main WhatsApp image burst repro, and only close or merge into the broader tracker after proof shows the variant is fixed or identical.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Tracker
options.body: Close as duplicate of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97538 if maintainers decide the image trigger adds no separate fix boundary.

options.title: Close After Main Proof
options.body: Close as implemented only if maintainers can cite a current-main commit and real WhatsApp proof that the multimodal active_reply_work loop now clears.

recommendation.title: Keep Focused Until Live Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, run a current-main WhatsApp image burst repro, and only close or merge into the broader tracker after proof shows the variant is fixed or identical.

likelyOwner.reason: They owned the newest adjacent stuck-session recovery close and are best positioned to judge whether that recovery change covers this variant.
